records.title: InsightChain: Optimized Chain-of-Insight Analytics for LLM-driven Data Visualization
records.reason: InsightChain develops multi-stage LLM analytics for data visualization and evaluates chain quality across ten domains. Its full text mentions AsymSpec only as a complementary response to context-growth inference cost; the method itself optimizes visualization reasoning/pipeline quality and reports no decoding, latency, memory or serving savings. The explicit linked speculative-decoding citation gives a weak lineage connection, but concrete runtime fit is not established.
